current.title: Best Phone Shot of the Month
current.summary: Share one photo you took on your phone this month. The judges pick the image with the strongest composition, story and use of the phone's camera.
current.prize: US$60 gift card (or local equivalent), plus a feature on Mobile.Direct
howToEnter: Upload your photo to any public link you control (Google Photos, Flickr, Instagram or Drive).
Fill in the entry form below with the link and the phone model you used.
One entry per person per month. Original work only.
